LanguageData.HE_Nord_Sword.label: Nordheim sword
LanguageData.HE_Nord_Sword.description: A broad double-edged sword with a pattern-welded blade and a lobed pommel. A jarl's gift to a loyal warrior.
LanguageData.HE_Nord_Sword.tools.0.label: pommel
LanguageData.HE_Nord_Sword.tools.1.label: point
LanguageData.HE_Nord_Sword.tools.2.label: edge
LanguageData.HE_Nord_DaneAxe.label: Dane axe
LanguageData.HE_Nord_DaneAxe.description: A thin, wide axe head on a haft as long as a man. Swung with both hands, it splits shields and helmets.
LanguageData.HE_Nord_DaneAxe.tools.0.label: haft
LanguageData.HE_Nord_DaneAxe.tools.1.label: edge
LanguageData.HE_Nord_HuntBow.label: hunting bow
LanguageData.HE_Nord_HuntBow.description: A plain elm bow strung with sinew. Light, quiet and accurate at hunting distances.
LanguageData.HE_Nord_HuntBow.tools.0.label: limb
LanguageData.HE_Nord_HarpoonGun.label: harpoon gun
LanguageData.HE_Nord_HarpoonGun.description: A heavy short-barrelled gun that fires a barbed iron harpoon. Slow and short-ranged, but whatever it hits stays hit.
LanguageData.HE_Nord_HarpoonGun.tools.0.label: stock
LanguageData.HE_Nord_HarpoonGun.tools.1.label: barrel
LanguageData.HE_Nord_Seax.label: seax
LanguageData.HE_Nord_Seax.description: A heavy single-edged knife with a broken back, carried by every free man. It is a tool at the table and a weapon in the shield wall.
LanguageData.HE_Nord_Seax.tools.0.label: handle
LanguageData.HE_Nord_Seax.tools.1.label: point
LanguageData.HE_Nord_Seax.tools.2.label: edge
LanguageData.HE_Nord_HookGun.label: hook gun
LanguageData.HE_Nord_HookGun.description: A heavy matchlock with an iron hook under the barrel to brace it on a wall or a rail. It kicks like a horse and hits like one.
LanguageData.HE_Nord_HookGun.tools.0.label: stock
LanguageData.HE_Nord_HookGun.tools.1.label: barrel
LanguageData.HE_Nord_Rifle.label: Nordic rifle
LanguageData.HE_Nord_Rifle.description: A bolt rifle with a pale birch stock and a box magazine on its side that is filled without opening the action, so it fires faster than other bolt rifles.
LanguageData.HE_Nord_Rifle.tools.0.label: stock
LanguageData.HE_Nord_Rifle.tools.1.label: barrel
